description: DI extension methods for the wireframe schema infrastructure. Use AddWireframeSchemas() in projects that reference only Tempo.Blazor.Abstractions (e.g. an API/MCP server project). The full AddTempoBlazor() call in the main Blazor package already calls this automatically.
